_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored. To find course_id, take the slug from your Classroom URL (classroom.google.com/c/<slug>) and base64-decode it: [Convert]::FromBase64String('<slug>') in PowerShell yields the numeric course ID.
_out_dir: Where to save images. Optional; defaults to 'images' beside the script. Relative paths are relative to the project folder, absolute ones are used as given. Files are filed into <out_dir>/YYYY/MM by post date. Backslashes must be escaped in JSON, or just use forward slashes.
_out_dir_lock: Optional. A lock file that another program holds while it works in out_dir, such as a backup that audits the folder. When set, the sync opens it exclusively for the whole run, and waits up to 90 minutes if that program has it. Leave empty when nothing else uses out_dir.
